200.description: The report rows for the window.

rows.description: One row per (pathId, hour bucket). Always present; empty for a window with no data.

pathId.description: Process path of the row. The empty string holds counters that have no path (ordersRepromised).

hourBucket.description: Start of the UTC hour this row aggregates.

ordersAllocationFailed.description: OrderAllocationPartiallyFailed events (hard, non-business allocation failure). Leakage.

ordersReleased.description: OrderReleased events (every line released; ADR 0034). Funnel exit.

promiseBasisCapability.description: Allocations whose promise basis was Capability (ADR 0019).

promiseBasisLeadTime.description: Allocations whose promise basis was the LeadTime fallback (ADR 0019).

promiseBasisNetwork.description: Allocations whose promise date was dictated by an external deadline (Network basis, ADR 0020).

ordersRepromised.description: OrderRepromised events (ADR 0018). Only non-zero on the row whose pathId is "".

ordersSplitShipment.description: Allocations whose order had more than one promise group (ADR 0017).

promiseToCutoffGapSeconds.description: Mean of (cutoff - allocation time) in seconds over Capability-basis promises in the bucket; 0 when there are none.

400.description: `from` or `to` is missing or not RFC 3339, or `granularity` is not `hour` (`invalid-report-query`).
